name: astronomy-essentials golden set
description: Synthetic 12-question golden set for the astronomy-essentials mini book. The 'student' role labels this set as the student-side question set for the role comparison table; in a real corpus the role should reflect the question provenance.

how long does earth take to orbit the sun and rotate on its axis
